dialogues.title: Showing your room
dialogues.situation: A classmate visits your dorm room for the first time and asks what is in it.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Is this your room, Minu?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say yes, this is my room (여기가 제 방이에요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Wow, what do you have in the room?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say there is a desk and a bed (책상하고 침대).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Do you have a TV too?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say no, there is no TV (텔레비전은 없어요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What is that photo over there?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say that one is a family photo (저것은 가족 사진).

dialogues.title: Talking about family
dialogues.situation: A friend sees you looking at a photo and asks about your family.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What are you doing now?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you are looking at a family photo (가족 사진을 봐요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: How many people are in your family?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say four: father, mother, older sister, and you (네 명이에요).
turns.ko: 네 명이에요. 아버지, 어머니, 누나하고 저예요.
accepted: 네 명이에요. 아버지, 어머니, 누나하고 저예요.
아버지, 어머니, 누나하고 저, 네 명이에요.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What does your father do?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say your father works at a bank (은행에서 일하세요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Does your sister work too?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say no, your sister studies history at university (대학교에서 역사를 공부해요).

dialogues.title: Talking about your day
dialogues.situation: A friend asks about your daily schedule and what you did yesterday.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What time do you usually get up?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you get up at seven (일곱 시에 일어나요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: From what time to what time is class?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say class runs from nine to one (아홉 시부터 한 시까지).
turns.ko: 아홉 시부터 한 시까지 수업이 있어요.
accepted: 아홉 시부터 한 시까지 수업이 있어요.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What did you do after class yesterday?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you did homework at the library (도서관에서 숙제를 했어요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: You're busy today too, right?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say yes, you study Korean until the evening (저녁까지 한국어를 공부해요).

dialogues.title: Talking about the weather
dialogues.situation: You chat with a friend about today's rain and your favorite season.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: How is the weather outside?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say it is raining right now (비가 오고 있어요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Really? It was clear this morning.

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say it seems it will rain tomorrow too (내일도 비가 올 것 같아요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Which season do you like?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you like winter more than summer (여름보다 겨울).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Why?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you can ski in winter (스키를 탈 수 있어요).

dialogues.title: Vacation plans
dialogues.situation: A friend asks about your plans for the school vacation.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: What will you do during the vacation?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you plan to take a trip to Busan (부산에 여행을 가려고 해요).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Nice! How long will you stay?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you will stay for a week (일주일 동안).

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.en: Do you travel often normally?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say no, you are busy so you cannot travel often (자주 못 해요).
turns.ko: 아니요, 바빠서 여행을 자주 못 해요.
accepted: 아니요, 바빠서 여행을 자주 못 해요.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.ko: 부산에 가기 전에 뭐 준비할 거예요?
turns.en: What will you prepare before going to Busan?

turns.speaker: 나
turns.en: Say you will buy a train ticket before you go (가기 전에 기차표를 살 거예요).
accepted: 부산에 가기 전에 기차표를 살 거예요.
